messages.author: 1b0c36948d072a34
messages.subject: Download issues - global climate errors
parts:
Hello, 

Hopefully this is a simple fix where I missed a step somewhere. 

I am downloading NicheMapR on a new computer and, while everything seems to have installed correctly, when I run a test after installing the global climate database, I get the following error:
 -
If program is crashing, try run.gads = 2.

extracting climate data

extracting soil moisture data
Error in .Fortran("gads", as.double(lat5), as.double(lon5), as.double(relhum),  :
  "gads" not available for .Fortran() for package "NicheMapR"

- 
If I add run.gads = 2, I then get this error: 
-
extracting climate data

extracting soil moisture data
running microclimate model for 12 days by 1 years at site long -81.8 lat 29.4

Note: the output column `SOLR` in metout and shadmet is for unshaded horizontal plane solar radiation

Error in .Fortran("microclimate", as.integer(doynum), as.double(micro$microinput),  :
  "microclimate" not available for .Fortran() for package "NicheMapR"
-

I'd appreciate any insight on what the error may be.  I am on a Mac updated to Monterey and am running the most recent fortran compiler for this OS. 

Thank you!

messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: Re: Download issues - global climate errors
parts:
Hi Sidney,

That means your Fortran is not compiling properly. I've had trouble getting Fortran to compile R packages on a Mac recently. Check that you've got the right version of R for your operating system and chip and the same for gfortran (I had trouble on my M1 Mac).

Good luck and let us know how you go.

All the best,
Mike
